explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/833: is there an absolute c > 0 such that for all r ≥ 2, every r-uniform hypergraph with chromatic number 3 has a vertex in at least (1+c)^r edges? Solved by Erdős–Lovász (a vertex has degree ≥ 2^{r-1}/(4r)). The statement asserts a uniform c over all r ≥ 2 and finite H on Fin n. That holds: for small r, max degree ≥ 2 (disjoint edges are 2-colourable), and for large r the 2^{r-1}/(4r) bound dominates. Faithful.
